text: ここで　へばって　ひきかえす　やつも　おおいぜ！

structure.jp: ひきかえす　やつも

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: へばって　ひきかえす　やつ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a word for a person or thing describes it. へばって　ひきかえす　やつ = 'people who get worn out and turn back'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: へばって　ひきかえす
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins two actions, one after the other, with the first leading to the second. へばって　ひきかえす = 'get worn out and turn back'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, tough-guy talk that pushes what you say at the listener. おおいぜ = 'there are plenty, I tell you'.
